english.title: Registered person fail to provide statement of costs to service user
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a person registered with the Care Quality Commission carrying out a regulated activity, namely **(..SPECIFY SERVICE..), where the service user, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) was responsible for paying the costs of care or treatment, failed to provide to that service user, or a person acting on their behalf, a statement containing the terms and conditions including the amount and method of payment of fees
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 19 and 25 of the Care Quality Commission (Registration) Regulations 2009.
english.pointstoprove:

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

english.notes: (i) Regulation 19(2) outlines that the statement provided must be in writing and as far as reasonably practicable, provided prior to the commencement of the services to which the statement relates
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), the defendant being a person registered with the Care Quality Commission carrying out a regulated activity, namely **(..SPECIFY SERVICE..), where the service user, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) was responsible for paying the costs of care or treatment, failed to provide to that service user, or a person acting on their behalf, a statement containing the terms and conditions including the amount and method of payment of fees.
